The main zombie from the mod, a key element needed
to begin your research journey!
-Regular zombies range from 2000+;
-For example, the Golfer zombie (quite rare) has a weight of 2000, while the Park Ranger has 10000.

Sandbox_zReV2_BookInWorldSpawnChance_too:
Affects the number of laboratory (mod) books in the world.
-Setting to 0 disables their world spawn;
-Does not affect book drops from special zombies.
Sandbox_zReV2_AntibodyPower_tooltip:
Affects the stage at which resistant antibodies activate.
-This perk is acquired by administering the level 4 vaccine;
-TERMINAL - at infection above 80%%, health drains, high chance of death;
-PRETERMINAL - at infection above 60%% (nausea, fever)(RECOMMENDED!);
-MODERATE - at infection above 40%% (mild nausea);
-INITIAL - at infection above 20%% (no symptoms).
Sandbox_zReV2_AntibodyPower2_tooltip:
Affects how quickly resistant antibodies clear the zombie virus from the body after activation.
-This perk is acquired by administering the level 4 vaccine;
-If potency = 6, then ~5%% infection is cleared per hour;
-If potency = 12, then ~10%% infection is cleared per hour;
-If potency = 24, then ~20%% infection is cleared per hour.
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType_tooltip:
Choose the result type for improving (researching) new vaccine levels.
-PROGRESSIVE CHANCE - upon failure, the next chance of success increases (accumulates);
-STATIC CHANCE - fixed percentage chance of success (30,20,14%% from second to fourth);
-FULL RESEARCH - has a hidden progress bar (100 units, conditionally, each research fills the bar).
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchRand_tooltip:
Only works with the vaccine improvement research types "PROGRESSIVE CHANCE" and "FULL RESEARCH"!
-In case of failed research, increases the result by a randomizer depending on this number (hereafter referred to as X);
-The formula works as:
Rand(X, X*2) for research up to level 2;
Rand(X*0.75, X*1.5) for research up to level 3;
Rand(X*0.5, X) for research up to level 4!
-Rounded up to the nearest integer;
-In simple terms: the randomizer decreases for researching a new vaccine by ~30%% on average.
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchReduceHealth_toolt: When performing the recipe "Take blood for further work" your health will be reduced by this value!
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchMinHealthNotificat:
